feed.title: NPR Programs: All Things Considered
feed.subtitle: All Things Considered hosts Ailsa Chang, Mary Louise Kelly, Juana Summers and Scott Detrow present the program's trademark mix of news, interviews, commentaries, reviews, and offbeat features 7 days a week.

entry.title: What to expect from Trump and Xi's upcoming meeting in China
entry.summary: Preview of what to expect as President Trump meets with Chinese leader Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin at the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China this week.

entry.title: The new album from the band Sylvie is like stepping into a time machine
entry.summary: NPR's Rob Schmitz speaks with Ben Schwab, frontman to the band Sylvie, about their new record New Season.

entry.title: Auction of rare Hilma af Klint artwork illuminates tensions over her legacy
entry.summary: The upcoming auction of a piece from Swedish abstract art pioneer Hilma af Klint has raised questions about control over her legacy.

entry.title: Movies set on farms tap into a rich vein of American mythology and symbolism
entry.summary: NPR White House Correspondent Danielle Kurtzleben and Tadeo Ruiz Sandoval, who covers agriculture for Harvest Public Media, talk about great American farm movies.

entry.title: Who makes Sydney Sweeney's American Eagle jeans — and under what conditions?
entry.summary: Sydney Sweeney has great jeans, American Eagle Outfitters tells us. But who made them? And what are working conditions like in the garment factories of Pakistan and Bangladesh?

entry.title: A new generation of disability rights activists carry on Judy Heumann's legacy
entry.summary: The film Being Heumann tells the lesser-known story of the mother of the disability rights movement. A new generation of activists share how they "carry the torch" today.

entry.title: Maintenance gone awry caused nation-wide ground stop, says Transportation Secretary
entry.summary: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy points blame toward contractor in explaining Friday's nation-wide aviation ground stop.

entry.title: Hello? James Gleick's new book compares the history of the telephone to the modern era
entry.summary: Have you ever wondered where phone etiquette or the idea for the first social network came from? Author James Gleick talks about his new book, The Telephone.

entry.title: An NPR correspondent on what she's learning following special education teachers all year
entry.summary: NPR's Jonaki Mehta talks about she learned from following special education teachers throughout a school year.

entry.title: Mathis Picard finds grounding in an uncertain world in his new album, The Sound Orchestra
entry.summary: French Malagasy pianist, composer, and producer Mathis Picard releases his newest album, The Sound Orchestra.
